good-enough.description: Coverage-first routine suite: broad unit and component coverage plus named cross-layer integration representatives that run to completion.

excluded_categories.package: Artifact builds and installed-package checks remain available through ./tests.sh package and exhaustive modes.

tests/core/test_live_reuse.py.rationale: Retain matching, never-reuse, unique greedy restore, ambiguous fallback, and failed-restore eviction; exhaustive mode covers equivalent stale/equal-node combinations.

tests/core/test_execute_integration.py.rationale: Retain real-worker payload withholding, output draining, Store publication/recovery, cleanup uncertainty, and cancellation; exhaustive mode covers repeated setup/cache compositions and callable-owner transport.

tests/core/test_execute_callables.py.rationale: Retain broad callable-owner invocation and copied-wrapper ownership; the real core and Dispatch representatives prove process transport and publication without repeating every owner cross-process.

tests/core/test_execute_managed_integrat.rationale: Retain one decorator-order product, malformed-config and independent-normalization validation, plus typed abstract-worker rejection and scoped result-materialization restoration; Dispatch retains the single explicit managed-config process proof.

tests/artifacts/test_fold_execution.py.rationale: Retain direct and real-subprocess Value/Fold publication, fresh lightweight restoration, and honest missing-input rerun failure; caller-supplied Ray remains explicit opt-in evidence.

tests/core/test_execute_results.py.rationale: Retain live publication, cyclic-result rejection, update withholding, post-publication evidence, and partial-replica failure; exhaustive mode covers repeated alias/materialization and limit compositions.

tests/core/test_execute_updates.py.rationale: Retain successful in-place update publication and ordered refresh-failure evidence; result and alias suites own the omitted fresh-result and descendant-coalescing compositions.

tests/core/test_repo_forks.py.rationale: Retain object/state identity, copied snapshot payloads, environment capture, pre-boundary failure, and post-boundary interruption; exhaustive mode covers the second seed/declaration failure shapes.

tests/core/test_repo_metadata.py.rationale: Retain metadata CRUD/value semantics, multistore conflict handling, invalid authority rejection, directory and Zip behavior, and fork copying; exhaustive mode covers repeated save-wrapper and closure shapes.

tests/core/test_metadata_query.py.rationale: Keep the complete pure predicate validation plus representative current, state, prepared-selector sidecar, conflict, projection, and Zip-backed query proofs; exhaustive mode covers equivalent composition permutations.

tests/core/test_pending_reference_save.p.rationale: Retain claim completion, nested unwind, explicit/routed exclusion, dependency failure, generation fencing, and route ordering; exhaustive mode covers equivalent claim failure windows.

tests/core/test_query_index.py.rationale: Retain authoritative refresh, exact-hit verification, deleted-index recovery, reference occurrence semantics, retired-root rejection, and strict unindexed rejection; exhaustive mode covers a second closure-root shape.

tests/core/test_query_graph_planner.py.rationale: Keep every dependency-free planner and backend-contract case plus one authoritative graph-query comparison; exhaustive mode covers repeated Store-backed no-enumeration and projection compositions.

tests/core/test_reference_query.py.rationale: Retain nonmaterializing scans, prepared-selector sidecars, aggregate identity, exact paths/aliases, nested state references, and conflicting-authority rejection as the complete reference-query boundary roster.

tests/core/test_repo_query_multistore.py.rationale: Retain distinct and replicated result identity, equivalent physical handles, stale refresh replacement, and structural-versus-exact state behavior; exhaustive mode covers ordering and duplicate refresh variants.

tests/core/test_repo_save_load.py.rationale: Retain public and explicit-store publication, failure atomicity, structural and reopened query authority, read-only main hydration, and exact nested/shared restoration; lower Store suites retain exhaustive format and publication branches.

tests/core/test_repo_save_routing.py.rationale: Retain policy normalization/validation, first/all selection, context leasing, per-object and closure routing, explicit-store bypass, and seed/reference distinctions; exhaustive mode covers additional equivalent graph shapes.

tests/core/test_state_ref_load.py.rationale: Retain shared-topology restoration, dependency ordering, and failed fresh-load cleanup as the complete exact-load integration boundary.

tests/core/test_state_ref_load_preflight.rationale: Retain missing authority, aggregate missing state, and pre-reservation failure as the complete exact-load preflight boundary.

tests/core/test_state_ref_receipt.py.rationale: Retain immutable empty receipts, completed-save retention, selected-root exact-load attachment, alias topology, and enclosing failure survival; exhaustive mode covers aggregate/reuse spelling repetitions.

tests/core/test_state_ref_restore_into.p.rationale: Retain identity-preserving restore, hook-failure invalidation, sibling invalidation, preflight safety, reference closure ordering, and pickle binding behavior as the complete targeted-restore roster.

tests/core/test_state_ref_save.py.rationale: Retain import rebasing, verified state publication, ephemeral topology, shared-node identity, deep recapture, and Zip authority; exhaustive mode covers duplicate ephemeral and unpublished-import shapes.

tests/core/test_zipstore_identity.py.rationale: Retain Zip round-trip, buffering/integrity, Repo and routed publication, no-op/stale commits, atomic replace and failure windows, stale-writer protection, process serialization, malformed archives, snapshot/reference hydration, close semantics, and concurrent mutation; exhaustive mode covers equivalent archive edge cases.

tests/managed/test_callbacks.py.rationale: Retain ordered receipt delivery, callback failure, disjoint and overlapping nested operations, checkpoint requests, and caught interruption; exhaustive mode covers repeated terminal/callback timing shapes.

tests/managed/test_execute_defaults.py.rationale: Retain the state/control product and representative omitted, lifetime, nesting, codec-repo, worker-setup, and missing-resource behavior; exhaustive mode covers copied-task and keyword-data variants.

tests/managed/test_lifecycle.py.rationale: Retain completion, descendant persistence, primary application failure, late requests, indeterminate completion, final-save failure, and runtime admission; exhaustive mode covers a second failure-recording composition.

tests/managed/test_repo_routing.py.rationale: Retain checkpoint/final replica routing, Zip commit success/failure/interruption, route-stable resume, partial-publication rejection, reopened closure validation, and borrowed-store ownership; exhaustive mode covers repeated closure/seed layouts.

tests/managed/test_signature_integration.rationale: Retain StateRef delivery, opposing-input and preflight rejection, return failure, interruption, pinned arguments, resume overlap, and claim-transfer failure; signature unit suites cover omitted normalization repetitions.

tests/managed/test_interruption.py.rationale: Retain explicit checkpoint interruption, external requests, checkpoint-backed keyboard interruption, and malformed-cause rejection; exhaustive mode covers no-checkpoint and disjoint nesting compositions.

tests/managed/test_rerun.py.rationale: Acceptance lifecycle retains completed-state rerun; keep pending-completion reconciliation and later checkpoint argument identity here.

tests/managed/test_status.py.rationale: Retain absent/wrong authority, owner loss, stale requests, spawned-owner exit, probe errors, generation replacement, and missing-lock behavior; exhaustive mode covers equivalent retained-key/store mismatch checks.

tests/dispatch/test_backend_execution.py.rationale: Retain real submit/run, exact-selector handoff, target-drift cleanup, borrowed-authority rejection, and primary cleanup ordering; core Execute owns repeated alias and wrapper transport proofs.

tests/dispatch/test_in_process.py.rationale: Retain direct invocation, interruption/lease release, deferred values, runtime and target rechecks, rebinding, failed admission, publication safety, and warning behavior; explain and admission suites cover omitted remote-probe and pin compositions.

tests/dispatch/test_managed_execution.py.rationale: Retain pre-run declaration conflict and one explicit subprocess managed-config proof; owning managed suites cover decorator, wrapper, discovery, and placement products.

tests/execute/test_subprocess_admission..rationale: Retain real environment and combined-axis admission, shared-authority release, portable synthetic CPU/GPU controls and rejection, and contention reprobe behavior; exhaustive mode covers duplicate real affinity/GPU observations.

tests/execute/test_subprocess_backend.py.rationale: Retain protocol/pin validation, real happy path and setup ordering, payload withholding, cleanup uncertainty/retry, callable failure, result bounds, STOP-before-deserialize, output uncertainty, cancellation cleanup, and Windows ownership; exhaustive mode covers duplicate process starts.

sampled_functions.tests/core/test_execute_managed_integrat: Genuine decorator-order by placement product; every member/order and placement value remains represented.
sampled_functions.tests/managed/test_execute_defaults.py::: Genuine nested-state by control-selection product; every value remains represented.

exhaustive_paths.tests/core/test_graph_save_failure.py: Store graph-save failure and cleanup proof.
exhaustive_paths.tests/core/test_snapshot_publication_fau: Store publication interruption and fault-window proof.
exhaustive_paths.tests/core/test_store_atomic_publication: Store filesystem publication, locking, and failure proof.
exhaustive_paths.tests/locking/test_advisory_locking.py: Native locking interruption and concurrency proof.

must_run.tests/core/test_execute_managed_integrat: Keep the real managed worker boundary even if parameter collection order changes.
must_run.tests/managed/test_execute_defaults.py::: Pin the nested state-plus-control interaction in addition to marginal axis coverage.
